version_name: V3.6: unified multimodal tasks and source-based learning artifacts
summary: Upgrade the multimodal prototype into a stable, unified and demo-friendly knowledge learning system.
implemented_features: Added source/document IDs and deep links for RAG citations.
Clarified upload workflows for document, image, audio and video sources.
Generated traceable learning artifacts from real source chunks.
Improved multi-keyframe extraction and video visual processing.
Improved task progress, event visibility and recovery controls.
Linked media player, transcript, keyframes and learning actions.
Unified media processing tasks in Task Center.
Verified release packaging exclusions and SHA256 output.

knowledge_points.name: Unified Task Model
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: Long-running work should have one durable state model, whether the target is a document or media source.
knowledge_points.project_usage: V3.6 uses target_type plus source_id/document_id so document ingestion and media processing share ingestion_jobs and job_events.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review task state machines, nullable foreign keys, retry/cancel semantics and worker dispatch.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I unified document and media processing under one durable task model, so progress, events, retries and cancellation work consistently across modalities.

knowledge_points.name: Media Task Orchestration
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: OCR, screenshot analysis, transcription and keyframe extraction are slow processing jobs, not instant UI actions.
knowledge_points.project_usage: MediaTaskService turns image OCR, visual description, screenshot analysis, audio transcription, video transcription, keyframes, keyframe OCR and full video pipeline into queueable jobs.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review provider preflight checks, staged progress, JobEvent logging, retry and cancellation.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I moved multimodal processing into a task service that records progress and failure details instead of hiding work inside synchronous buttons.

knowledge_points.name: Real-Mode Provider Boundaries
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: Uploading a file is not the same as understanding it; missing provider keys must be explicit.
knowledge_points.project_usage: V3.6 keeps NOT_CONFIGURED behavior for OCR, vision and transcription, and refuses to create fake subtitles or fake learning material.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review provider adapters, ConfigurationError, NOT_CONFIGURED codes and long-term knowledge-base contamination risk.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I kept media management separate from model understanding so real mode never silently writes fake OCR, fake captions or fake notes.

knowledge_points.name: Citation Deep Links
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: A citation should take the learner back to the evidence, not just name a file.
knowledge_points.project_usage: Chat citations now carry source_id/document_id and timestamp fields; CitationPanel links to document chunks or media timestamps.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review citation payloads, URL query parameters, player seek and highlighted transcript chunks.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I connected RAG citations to frontend routes so audio and video answers can jump to the exact timestamp that supports the answer.

knowledge_points.name: Video Keyframes
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: Video knowledge includes visible frames, not only the audio track.
knowledge_points.project_usage: V3.6 extracts multiple deduplicated keyframes, displays them on a timeline, and can run keyframe OCR or visual description with real providers.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review FFmpeg extraction, perceptual dedupe, VisualFrame, MediaAsset and timestamp locators.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I expanded video from a single poster into a traceable keyframe timeline that can feed OCR and visual analysis.

knowledge_points.name: Source-Based Learning Artifacts
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: Learning cards and notes should be traceable to real evidence chunks.
knowledge_points.project_usage: LearningArtifact records link generated knowledge points, cards, quizzes, notes and interview expressions back to document or multimodal chunks.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review audit tables, deterministic transformations, chunk locators and refusal when no real text exists.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I made source-derived learning material auditable, so every generated card or note can point back to real project evidence.

knowledge_points.name: Demo-Friendly Frontend
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: A user-facing OS should explain the next action without exposing raw internal fields on primary screens.
knowledge_points.project_usage: V3.6 improves Upload Center, Task Center and media detail pages with clearer steps, result links, transcript highlighting and keyframe browsing.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review workflow cards, task filters, media player state, responsive layout and progressive disclosure.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I reshaped the frontend around user workflows: upload, process, inspect evidence, ask questions and turn evidence into learning assets.

knowledge_points.name: Release Verification
knowledge_points.beginner_explanation: A release package must be reproducible and must not include dependencies, caches, secrets or user data.
knowledge_points.project_usage: V3.6 keeps release.py exclusion rules and adds tests/checks for forbidden archive entries.
knowledge_points.review_suggestion: Review zip packaging, SHA256 checks, exclusion rules and acceptance reports.
knowledge_points.interview_expression: I treated release packaging as part of the product boundary, verifying that generated archives exclude secrets, databases, uploads and build caches.

focus: Understand how V3.6 unifies multimodal processing, evidence navigation and learning artifact generation around real source chunks.
review_suggestions: Review unified task model, media task orchestration, citation deep links, player synchronization, keyframes, learning artifact audit trails and release verification.
interview_expression: In AI Knowledge OS Pro V3.6, I unified image, audio and video processing under the durable Task Center, made RAG citations jump to document chunks or media timestamps, and generated learning assets only from real source evidence.
next_version_suggestion: Next, add subtitle export, richer scene segmentation, stronger provider diagnostics and visual-frame retrieval.
